blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Supreme Court Senior Associate Justice Marvic Leonen said cleaning the ranks and decongesting court dockets would be his top priorities if he is named the next chief justice. During his panel interview with the Judicial and Bar Council (JBC) on Thursday, Leonen was asked by Sen. Francis Pangilinan how he would address rumors of “transactional rulings” among judges and justices if he took the helm. “What you stated, I will not contradict… You say something about transactional cases, but I will say, it’s not all cases,” said Leonen, who was appointed by the late President Benigno Aquino III.
